q1_files_changed_by_fix.description: repo-relative paths the leaf that fixed the planted fault changed; [] if unknown

q2_why_in_agents_words.description: the reason the fixing agent gave, quoted or closely paraphrased; null if the material does not say

q3_refused_commands_count.description: how many shell commands the executors themselves were refused (not writes the hooks refused); null if unknown

q3_refused_command_example.description: one such command, verbatim; null if none or unknown

q4_check_passed_at_base_leaf.description: the id of a leaf whose check already passed at the base commit before any work; null if none or unknown

q5_planner_dollars.description: the planner's dollars at list price; null if unknown

q5_total_dollars.description: the whole plan's dollars at list price (planner and executors); null if unknown

q6_max_leaves_at_once.description: the most leaves that ran at the same time; null if unknown

q7_came_back_leaf.description: the id of the leaf that came back (was handed back by its executor); null if none or unknown

q7_came_back_why.description: why it came back, in a sentence; null if unknown

q7_reopened_leaf.description: the id of the leaf that was reopened to fix the fault; null if none or unknown

q8_waits_on_person.description: what waits on the person now (proposals to accept, board items, leaves in review, a leaf that came back), in a sentence; null if nothing or unknown

q9_fix_merge_sha.description: the sha (7 or more hex characters) of the merge commit that landed the fix; null if unknown

q10_leaves_added_after_accept.description: how many leaves were added to the plan after the person first accepted it; null if unknown

cited.description: for each answer, the line or file you read it from, briefly
